label: Men's ODI
methodology: The 100 most recent eligible international matches in the downloaded archive. First innings only, replayed at completed-over checkpoints using only deliveries available at that checkpoint. Full-length six-ball-over matches, including all-out innings that reached all checkpoints; rain-adjusted and no-result matches excluded. Historical replay of the current model, not an out-of-time training holdout. Existing model priors and learned adjustments may incorporate historical information. Eligibility favours longer innings; this is not a random sample of all matches. ODI model revisions were evaluated against this same cohort; these are calibration results, not a held-out evaluation.
summary: Across 400 predictions the model has an MAE of 41.8 runs and RMSE of 56.5 runs. Bias is -3.7 runs (the model undershoots on average). The predicted range captures the actual score 46.2% of the time with an average range width of 65 runs. Error by final score bucket: low-scoring (<160): 39.0 runs MAE, mid-range (160–200): 34.8 runs MAE, high-scoring (200+): 43.0 runs MAE. Predictions are least accurate at the 10-over checkpoint (MAE 57.8 runs) and most accurate at 40 overs (MAE 22.7 runs).
